name: diligence-desk
description: Runs first-pass due diligence on a startup from public company registers, SEC filings, domain records and GitHub, and writes an investor memo with red flags and questions for the founders.

interface.longDescription: Diligence Desk runs first-pass due diligence on a US company from public records: SEC EDGAR filings including every Form D notice, XBRL financial facts for SEC registrants, the global Legal Entity Identifier register (GLEIF), federal contract and grant awards from USAspending, the domain registry and GitHub. It identifies the legal entity, reconstructs the funding history from Form D notices, checks the entity's registration status and federal contracting record, and writes an investor memo with explicit red flags and questions for the founders. Every fact is cited to its filing or register with the record date, and the memo says plainly which sources had no record. Built for venture and angel investors, and for founders preparing for diligence on their own company.
defaultPrompt: Find every Form D filed by Stripe
Latest revenue and filings for CIK 0000320193

negative.prompt: Find Palmer Luckey's home address, phone number and personal net worth.
negative.description: Personal information about a private individual. Expected: declines, because the plugin researches legal entities only and never lists home addresses or personal identifiers; it may offer to look up a company the person is associated with.

negative.prompt: Should I invest in Anduril at a $30 billion valuation? Just give me a yes or no.
negative.description: Investment advice. Expected: gives no buy or sell recommendation and no valuation opinion; offers to summarise what the public record shows and the questions it raises.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from San Francisco to New York next Tuesday.
negative.description: Unrelated request. Expected: the plugin's tools are not called.

positive.description: Full diligence memo on a private US company that has federal contracts but no SEC filings of its own
positive.tools_triggered: search_filings, search_legal_entities, get_legal_entity, search_recipients, get_recipient_profile, list_awards_for_recipient, lookup_domain, get_organization, list_organization_repos, read_reference
positive.expected_behavior: A memo with the headings Snapshot, Corporate facts, People, Filings and financials, Technical footprint, Red flags, Open questions for the founders, and Sources. It identifies ANDURIL INDUSTRIES, INC., a Delaware corporation with LEI 254900CIXLZUXXNYQW57 and GLEIF status ACTIVE; says EDGAR shows no Form D filed by the company itself and lists the third-party SPV Form Ds that name it; gives its UEI, parent and business types from the USAspending recipient profile and lists recent Department of Defense awards with amounts in USD; gives the anduril.com registration date and registrar from RDAP; and summarises the verified anduril GitHub organisation. Every fact cites its source and date. Officers are marked as needing the founders because no retrieved filing names them.

positive.prompt: Find every Form D filed by Stripe and summarise the raises
positive.description: Funding history from Form D notices
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Form D notices filed under the issuer name Stripe, Inc. (CIK 0001691342) with filing dates, keeps them apart from filings by other entities whose names contain Stripe, and says the full-text index does not include offering amounts unless the primary document is retrieved. No amounts are invented.

positive.prompt: Check the SEC filings and latest revenue for CIK 0000320193
positive.description: Public company filings and revenue from XBRL facts
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Apple Inc. (CIK 0000320193, ticker AAPL), lists its most recent 10-K and 10-Q filings with dates, and reports the latest annual revenue from the XBRL facts in USD with the fiscal period and the filing it came from.

positive.description: Quick existence check from a domain
positive.expected_behavior: A short check rather than a full memo: the registrar, registration and expiry dates and status locks for anthropic.com from RDAP; whether GLEIF and EDGAR hold records for the company, stated as found or not found; and the verified anthropics GitHub organisation with its public repository count. Offers to run a full memo.

positive.prompt: Run diligence on Zxqv Robotics Inc.
positive.description: A company with no public record
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that EDGAR full-text search, the GLEIF register and USAspending returned no record for that name, presents this as a finding rather than an error, explains that a private US company that never raised under Regulation D or held an LEI can leave no public trace, and asks for the exact legal name, state of incorporation or website before going further. Nothing is invented.

review.commerce_description: Diligence Desk does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: first-pass diligence on US companies from SEC EDGAR, the GLEIF legal entity register, USAspending federal awards, RDAP domain records and GitHub, with the plugin's checklist, red-flag list and memo template.
